verdict.rationale: Vue's docs say it builds on standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript [vue-docs-3]. A community user praises keeping a component's HTML, JS and styles together in one component [vue-comm-8], and TSX is described as usable [vue-comm-2]. One user finds the template syntax a DSL that is harder than plain JavaScript for complex renders [vue-comm-10]; that is a criticism, not a contradiction of the capability. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the single-file component format (markup + script + style in one file), explicit docs on scoped styles within components, stronger independent corroboration that the template syntax feels like a familiar language.
